nodes.title: What might be happening?
nodes.body:
Sex characteristics encompass several biological traits that do not necessarily align in every individual. Gender identity is a different construct. Good research defines what matters to the specific question and measures it directly where possible; a broad category should not be used as a substitute for a characteristic it did not assess.

A simple category can be appropriate for a clearly stated descriptive purpose. The mistake is interpreting it as a precise measure of an unasked characteristic.
